result:
Question 91 is logged, so I added nothing more to the notes.

Nothing shipped on this run.

- **Right-column overlap (34, downed with pickups):** already gone on HEAD (v34.31). In fresh 1080p pictures no two text boxes in the right column touch. The 4K picture scales the same way. I did not shoot a P2 window, but the draw code has no per-seat layout. No check was written, because the old build doesn't fail.
- **Repeated warning (33, fight alerts):** it is now drawn twice, not three times. For example, "the pillbox has seen you" shows as the red banner and again as a row in the left feed. The cause is that every line said on screen also goes into the feed, which is his 10-15 order (cw-feedall). Removing the copies would reverse that order, so I left both and logged question 91 in `questions.md`.
- **Critic:** scored 2 on 34 and 2 on 33 using the HEAD pictures. For 34, the main finding is that the downed card is a flat box rather than the standard panel. Its other findings are the wrapping contract rows and the staggered right-hand chips. For 33, the main finding is the controls cheat-sheet in the centre, which shows on the first raid only. Its other findings are the red tint over the whole frame and the right-hand panels.

Next work is two separate tasks: restyle the downed card as the standard panel with one red bar, and fix the wrap in the run-info rows.

NEXT: pick up the next queued screen the critic scored under target.

TASK PARTIAL: the right-column overlap is gone, but 34 and 33 still score 2; the downed card restyle and run-info wrap need their own tasks, and question 91 (banner plus feed) is open.
